source_text: Decisions that are hard to reverse or expensive to change deserve a written design doc (ADR) recording the alternatives considered and why they were rejected.
pattern: Decisions that are hard to reverse or expensive to change deserve a written design doc (ADR) recording the alternatives considered and why they were rejected.
reason: A written record prevents re-litigating settled decisions.

source_text: Prefer the simplest design that meets requirements; add abstraction only when a second concrete use case demands it (Rule of Three / YAGNI).
pattern: Prefer the simplest design that meets requirements; add abstraction only when a second concrete use case demands it (Rule of Three / YAGNI).
reason: Unneeded abstraction is a maintenance tax.

source_text: Define module boundaries by what changes together and for the same reason (cohesion); a component with two reasons to change is a future bug farm.
pattern: Define module boundaries by what changes together and for the same reason (cohesion); a component with two reasons to change is a future bug farm.
reason: Cohesion is the cheapest bug prevention.

source_text: Model the data and its invariants before the UI or the API; most design errors are data-model errors discovered late.
pattern: Model the data and its invariants before the UI or the API; most design errors are data-model errors discovered late.
reason: Late data-model errors are the most expensive to fix.

source_text: Every architecture choice is a tradeoff; a design that lists no alternatives and no costs has not been designed, only sketched.
pattern: Every architecture choice is a tradeoff; a design that lists no alternatives and no costs has not been designed, only sketched.
reason: Naming the rejected alternatives is what makes a design defensible.
